description: Frozen pointer/length ABI of apps/site/rotor_wasm.wasm at P0. Names, parameter counts and result arity are checked against the committed artifact by scripts/check-wasm-abi.mjs. `result` is the one-line buffer/return semantics; it documents the contract, the binary cannot check it. The memory export is required but is not a function and is not listed here.

exports.name: alloc
exports.result: u32 pointer to `len` zero-initialized bytes (8 for zero length, 0 on failure)

exports.name: dealloc
exports.result: no return; frees an `alloc` pointer/length pair (no-op for 0/0)

exports.name: set_job
exports.result: i32 status: 0 ok; nonzero with the error buffer set

exports.name: scan
exports.result: i32 status: 0 ok; result blob = u64 scanned + u32 found [+ u32 len/key + u32 len/address]

exports.name: samples
exports.result: i32 status: 0 ok; result blob = u32 count then per sample u32 length + bytes
